notes.unpaired_src_limitation: research UNPAIRED_SRC sampled b != a and therefore teaches anti-identity, not source-target independence.
notes.blocked_limitation: research IDENT_BLOCKED blocks direct query-segment attention to the source event but not all multi-layer indirect paths through SEP or other context positions.
notes.rebinding_definition: T and swapped S have the same token bag; correct target changes from old RWT to new RWT. True binding should prefer old in T and new in S.
